vietqr.title: Scan to pay by bank transfer
vietqr.intro: Open your banking app and scan the QR code below. The account number, amount and reference will be filled in automatically.
vietqr.note: Please keep the transfer reference unchanged so we can match your payment to this order. Your order is processed once we confirm the payment.
vietqr.notConfigured: The shop has not configured a bank account for transfers yet. Please contact us for payment instructions.
